bio.text: Rick Allen was elected in 2014 to represent Georgia's 12th Congressional District in the U.S. House and serves on the Energy and Commerce and Education and the Workforce committees.
At 25 he founded the construction company R.W. Allen & Associates, which his biography says has operated for 50 years.
He earned a B.S. in Building Construction from Auburn University and lives in Augusta.
